COLOR_SANDSTONE_CINEMATIC.name: Egyptian Sandstone Cinematic Look
COLOR_SANDSTONE_CINEMATIC.description: Warm organic sunlit stones (#f4ecd8 highlights) balanced against dark teal shadows (#1a1d24) and rich weapon textures.
COLOR_SANDSTONE_CINEMATIC.editing_technique: Film emulation with gentle S-curve contrast, soft highlight rolloff and subtle orange-teal complementary split.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Node 1 (Exposure/Balance) -> Node 2 (Curves: Lift 0.02, Gain 0.95) -> Node 3 (Split Tone: Shadows teal +3, Highlights warm +4) -> Node 4 (LUT: Sandstone Cinematic)
